 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. CHEMSDINE TALBI will make his first league start of the season as Sunderland host Chelsea in the Premier League this afternoon.
 Talbi has been handed a starting spot as part of eight changes from the team that kicked off Thursday night's Europa League defeat to Dinamo Zagreb.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nordi Mukiele has completed the concussion protocols that were imposed after he was forced off in the draw with Leeds United, with the Frenchman set to partner Luke O'Nien at centre-half.
 Reinildo Mandava returns at left-back, with Dayann Methalie dropping back down to the bench, with Thomas Meunier on the opposite flank.
 Granit Xhaka and Noah Sadiki are reunited in central midfield, with Trai Hume returning to his advanced midfield role on the right-hand side.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Talbi is set to start on the opposite flank, with Enzo Le Fee playing off central striker Brian Brobbey.
 Former Sunderland midfielder Jordan Henderson starts in midfield for Chelsea.
 SUNDERLAND (4-2-3-1): Roefs; Meunier, Mukiele, O'Nien, Reinildo; Xhaka, Sadiki; Hume, Le Fee, Talbi; Brobbey. 
 Subs: Ellborg, Danso, Methalie, Angulo, Rigg, Isidor, Fofana, Tutierov, Ahoka. 
 CHELSEA (4-3-3): Penders; Palestra, Fofana, Colwill, Chavarria; Lavia, Caicedo, Henderson; Palmer, Rogers, Neto. 
 Subs: Sharman-Lowe, Anselmino, Gusto, Barco, Nicoll-Jazuli, Quenda, Estevao, Welbeck, Emegha.
